description: This file defines the 'Image' class within the OpenCart system, providing functionality to load, manipulate, and save images (resize, crop, watermark, rotate, etc.) while integrating with the GD PHP extension.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A class encapsulating image loading, processing, and saving functionalities, supporting formats like GIF, PNG, JPEG, and WebP, with methods for resizing, cropping, rotating, watermarking, and saving images.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Image object by loading an image file, verifying GD extension, and extracting image properties.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the filename of the loaded image.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image resource or object.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getBits
methods.description: Returns the bit depth of the image.

methods.name: getMime
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the image to a specified file, supporting different formats based on file extension.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the image to specified dimensions with scaling options.

methods.name: watermark
methods.description: Applies a watermark image onto the current image at a specified position.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops the image to specified coordinates.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the image by a given degree with optional background color.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Adds text overlay to the image.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another image onto this image at specified position and opacity.

methods.name: html2rgb
methods.description: Converts HTML color codes to RGB array.
